item.title: Understanding Copyright Strikes
item.description:
If you get a copyright strike, it means that a content owner requested the removal of their copyright-protected content from your video. We review the removal request, and if it appears to be valid we remove the video from YouTube (and issue a strike) to comply with copyright law. We'll walk you through what options you have when you receive a copyright strike.
